input.text: Dies gilt oder Ordnung halber wegen nichts.

_note: Without a \\b word boundary before (?:der|des|dem), the regex engine could match the literal substring 'der' at the TAIL of an unrelated word like 'oder' ('or'), then treat 'oder Ordnung' as a false 'der Ordnung' citation. The \\b guard requires der/des/dem to be a WHOLE word.
